analyst.summary: Federal Bank posted a clean, decadal-best Q1 FY27 (GNPA 1.52%, NNPA 0.18%, credit cost 0.41%, NIM 3.33%, CASA ratio 32.23%) on top of a Q4 FY26 that included flagged one-off items; CEO KVS Manian is mid-way through a settled 3-year RBI-approved term with no near-term regulatory binary; valuation at ~2.1-2.3x P/B is a premium to sector average but broadly consistent with the bank's own guided ROE/ROA-improvement path rather than obviously stretched.
